title: Efficient Ag/La-ZnO core–shell catalyst for green synthesis of 4H-pyrano[2,3-c] pyrazoles
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,26013-26026
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA02788H, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Hrishikesh Labhade, Sharad Gaikwad, Jaidip Wable, Amol Kategaonkar, Samin Shaikh
A green and sustainable protocol for pyrazole synthesis using Ag/La-ZnO core–shell nanocatalyst under solvent-free, grinding condition at room temperature offers excellent yields, operational simplicity, and catalyst reusability.
